estimates: The exterior represents the restored mansion at 26 Yanping South Road as it reopened in 2009. The model covers the named building and public street arcade.

The municipal description establishes the sandstone arches, timber upper floor, washed aggregate, copper mansard and three dormers. Exact roof pitches, profiles, sash arrangement and side and rear elevations are estimated.
The original elevation field is preserved. The rendered sidewalk, thresholds and column feet have approximate grade registration.

review.notes: Qualla was checked first. Its CC0 candidate depicts the nearby Ningxia Night Market, and the direct mansion photographs have attribution licenses. The Ministry archive color study has a CC0 object record and an unidentified underlying photograph. Architectural geometry follows the municipal descriptions and original map.
